senses.zh_definition: 托雷托：姓氏；例如电影《速度与激情》系列人物多米尼克·托雷托的姓。
senses.en_definition: A surname, borne for example by the fictional character Dominic Toretto in the Fast & Furious films.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, misalnya nama keluarga watak rekaan Dominic Toretto dalam siri filem Fast & Furious.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此表示专有名词。它不是马来语中表示赛车手、家人或强壮男子的普通名词。以下为专名组合，不声称具有经过语料验证的高频搭配地位。[Universal：The Fast and the Furious](https://www.universalpicturesathome.com/movies/the-fast-and-the-furious)

etymology.historical_story: Toretto is identifiable in popular culture as the surname of Dominic Toretto, played by Vin Diesel in the 2001 film The Fast and the Furious. This establishes a documented cultural reference, not the historical origin of the surname. Without a reliable surname history, a translation or an attractive story about its supposed Italian components would be speculative. [Universal：电影资料](https://www.universalpicturesathome.com/movies/the-fast-and-the-furious)
